headline: Can 'eSUV' e-bikes really go from trail to town?
summary: eSUV e-bikes claim to seamlessly transition between urban and off-road environments. They feature all-terrain tires, full suspension, and practical accessories. The article investigates if these versatile bikes live up to their promises.

headline: Roku's first OLED TVs are up to $400 off, starting at $699
summary: Roku's new OLED TVs are now available with significant discounts. The 55-inch Pro Series model, initially $999, can be found for $699. These TVs offer a 120Hz OLED panel, HDMI 2.1 ports, and Dolby Vision support.

headline: Phones don't have lights
summary: Mark Zuckerberg defends Ray-Ban Meta glasses by highlighting their privacy features. He notes the glasses have a visible light to indicate photo-taking. Zuckerberg argues this offers clearer signaling than smartphones for user privacy.

headline: These camera apps give you more control over the iPhone 18 Pro's aperture
summary: The iPhone 18 Pro's native camera app limits aperture settings to just four options. Third-party camera apps offer enhanced manual control over the variable aperture. Users can achieve greater photographic flexibility beyond iOS app restrictions.

headline: Marvel's Wolverine Dev Adds Option to Turn Off Controversial Scent Trails and More in New Update
summary: Insomniac Games has released a new update for Marvel's Wolverine. The update allows players to disable the previously controversial scent trails for collectibles. This change addresses direct player feedback concerning a debated game feature.

headline: Chris Hansen Announces His Own Documentary After Watching 'Fever Dream' Primetime and Grades Movie a D
summary: Chris Hansen is producing his own documentary after critiquing 'Primetime'. He watched the dramatized film and graded it a 'D'. Hansen aims to offer his own factual account to counter the fictionalized version of events.

headline: How to Play the Silent Hill Games in Order
summary: This guide provides the correct chronological order for playing the Silent Hill series. It helps players navigate the complex narrative timeline of the games. Essential for fans who want to experience the story coherently.

headline: EA Sports FC 27 Review
summary: EA Sports FC 27 receives a mixed review, standing on shaky ground with its new open-world hub. Despite this, the game's realistic and intuitive Tactics system shows significant promise. The review explores both the innovative and challenging aspects of the new title.

headline: Clubs seek legal advice after Man City found guilty over financial rule breaches
summary: Premier League clubs are seeking legal counsel regarding Manchester City's financial rule breaches. They are exploring potential cases for financial compensation. This follows Man City being found guilty of violating financial regulations.

headline: The computer hacker who tried to take down Man City
summary: BBC Sport investigated Rui Pinto, the hacker behind the Manchester City financial probe. Pinto's actions sparked the major investigation into the football club. The report details his role in uncovering alleged financial rule breaches.

headline: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
summary: Iran has proposed a deal to the US for reopening the strategic Strait of Hormuz. The offer suggests the waterway could be reopened within seven days. US officials confirm 'constructive discussions' are underway via mediators.

headline: Burnham not doing enough to boost growth, says former business secretary
summary: Former Business Secretary Peter Kyle criticizes Andy Burnham's efforts to boost economic growth. Kyle calls for greater urgency on economic matters from Burnham. These comments surface as Labour members attend their annual conference.
